Next year marks the 20th anniversary of the iPhone launch, and rumours suggest the iPhone Pro models will feature a completely refreshed design. The latest leak has revealed the larger display sizes that are reportedly set to be adopted.

iPhone Pro to feature larger 6.4-inch and 7-inch displays next year

When the iPhone celebrated its 10th anniversary in 2017, Apple prepared a particularly meaningful model: the iPhone X.

There are rumours that the company is preparing an equally distinctive release for next year's 20th anniversary.

The iPhone Pro models next year are reported to feature fully curved, bezel-less displays on all four sides, with the screen extending to the edges of the body.

The Dynamic Island cutout may be reduced or even eliminated, creating a more seamless all-glass appearance.

According to the latest post by tipster Digital Chat Station, Apple is also preparing new display sizes. He says the company is testing the following configurations:

  • iPhone Pro: 6.4-inch, up from the current 6.3-inch
  • iPhone Pro Max: 7-inch, up from the current 6.9-inch

He added that both models will see an increase in overall body size, but will maintain the aspect ratio of the current models. In other words, the larger screens are not only due to narrower bezels.

Apple last increased the display sizes of the Pro models in 2024, when the iPhone 16 Pro went from 6.1-inch to 6.3-inch, and the Pro Max went from 6.7-inch to 6.9-inch.

Although the screen size increases next year don't sound particularly significant, combined with the fully curved design, the actual in-hand feel should feel refreshingly new.

What are your thoughts on the rumoured design for next year's iPhone Pro models? Feel free to share them in the comments section.
